stories.h: Coastal flooding, wind and atmospheric rivers hit western WA
stories.s: King tides plus a strong storm bring Friday coastal flood alerts from Whatcom to Hood Canal (warning in San Juan County), coast gusts to 50 mph, and a Skokomish River flood watch. Heavier rain and wind arrive Saturday night.

stories.h: Orcas Island turns to barges as ferry dock limits trucks
stories.s: With trucks over 22 feet barred from the cracked Orcas ferry ramp for up to two weeks, private barges carry just three or four trucks a day; garbage is piling up and the county seeks state aid.

stories.h: Republicans fall to superminority in state House
stories.s: After losing at least nine seats, Republicans will hold just 29 of 98 House seats. State GOP chair Jim Walsh plans to seek another term despite a challenge and criticism from Gov. Ferguson.

stories.h: Democrat edges ahead in 25th District House race
stories.s: Democrat Jenn Marie Strickling took a narrow lead over GOP Rep. Cyndy Jacobsen in the 25th District, a race likely headed for a recount that could give Democrats up to 10 new House seats.

stories.h: Ocean Shores under boil-water advisory after main break
stories.s: A contractor damaged a south-end water main in Ocean Shores, already under an erosion emergency. Residents south of Marine Drive should boil water; bottled water is at 165 Ocean Lake Way.

talking.h: Kraken drop Helsinki opener to Hurricanes, 4-1
talking.s: Finnish star Sebastian Aho scored twice as Carolina beat Seattle in the Kraken's first regular-season game outside North America. Freddy Gaudreau scored Seattle's lone goal.

talking.h: Mariners' Ian Happ buzz cools within a day
talking.s: Reports linking free agent Ian Happ to Seattle's left-field hole quickly met local skepticism, with sources calling him an unlikely fit; Seiya Suzuki is floated as a likelier target.

talking.h: Rep. Strickland apologizes for missing Hegseth impeachment vote
talking.s: U.S. Rep. Marilyn Strickland said she arrived a minute late to the 211-204 House vote that sent articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to committee, effectively stalling them.

coming.h: Kraken vs. Hurricanes, Game 2 in Helsinki
coming.s: Seattle closes the NHL Global Series at 10 a.m. PT on KING 5/KONG and Prime Video.
UW visits Spartan Stadium at 1:15 p.m. PT on BTN.

coming.h: Seahawks at Raiders in Las Vegas
coming.s: Seattle plays the Raiders in Las Vegas on Sunday; kickoff is 1:05 p.m. PT on CBS.
The Economic and Revenue Forecast Council meets at noon in Olympia with the November revenue forecast, a key input for next year's budget.
